summary: Post-Session Summary feature fully tested. All 18 tests passed covering: summary generation with all required fields (trainerName, durationMinutes, caloriesEstimate, weeklyStreak, shareText, deepLink), on-demand auto-generation for completed sessions, 400 for non-completed sessions, 403 for non-participants, GET /api/sessions/summaries/my with totalSessions/totalCalories/totalMinutes aggregation, public share-card endpoint excluding personal IDs, POST /api/sessions/{id}/end auto-generates summary, calorie estimation accuracy, weekly streak calculation, and share text format validation.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped - React Native/Expo app not testable via Playwright

critical_code_review_comments: CALORIES_PER_HOUR dict (lines 2485-2494): Correctly maps training styles - HIIT=650, Strength=420, Yoga=250, Cardio=500 as specified
estimate_calories() (lines 2498-2512): Correctly averages cal/hr for multiple styles and calculates based on duration
generate_session_summary() (lines 2515-2599): Creates full summary with all required fields, persists to session_summaries collection with upsert
get_session_summary() (lines 2602-2630): Returns existing summary or auto-generates if completed but missing, validates participant access (403), validates session status (400)
get_my_summaries() (lines 2633-2654): Returns summaries list with aggregate totalSessions, totalCalories, totalMinutes
get_share_card_data() (lines 2657-2684): Public endpoint, excludes traineeId/trainerId in projection, returns styled card object
end_session() (lines 2687-2760): Auto-calls generate_session_summary() at line 2746, sends notification with summary stats
seed_data_creation: Test sessions created directly in MongoDB with status='completed' for each test, cleaned up after each test. Trainer1 profile has trainingStyles: [strength, hiit, cardio]
context_for_next_testing_agent: Post-Session Summary feature fully tested (P3). Key verified flows: (1) GET /api/sessions/{id}/summary returns trainerName, durationMinutes, caloriesEstimate, weeklyStreak, shareText, deepLink - auto-generates on-demand if session completed, (2) GET /api/sessions/{id}/summary returns 400 for non-completed, 403 for non-participants, (3) GET /api/sessions/summaries/my returns summaries array with totalSessions/totalCalories/totalMinutes aggregation, (4) GET /api/sessions/{id}/share-card is PUBLIC (no auth), excludes traineeId/trainerId, returns card object, (5) POST /api/sessions/{id}/end auto-generates summary (verified summary exists in DB after call), (6) Calorie formula verified: trainer1 styles [strength,hiit,cardio] avg = (420+650+500)/3 = 523 cal/hr, 45-min = 392 cal, 30-min = 261 cal - CORRECT, (7) Deep link format: rapidreps://session-summary/{sessionId}, (8) Share text format: 'Just crushed a {duration}-min {workout} session with {trainer}! {cal} cal burned. {streak}-week streak!'

mocked_apis.note: Notifications are fire-and-forget, don't block summary generation

business_rules_verified.calorie_formula: HIIT=650, Strength=420, Yoga=250, Cardio=500 cal/hr - averaged for trainer styles, multiplied by duration/60
business_rules_verified.calorie_example: Trainer with [strength, hiit, cardio]: (420+650+500)/3 = 523 cal/hr. 45-min = 392 cal, 30-min = 261 cal - VERIFIED
business_rules_verified.weekly_streak: Counts consecutive past weeks with at least 1 completed session
business_rules_verified.share_text_format: 'Just crushed a {duration}-min {workout} session with {trainer}! {cal} cal burned. {streak}-week streak!'
business_rules_verified.share_card_privacy: traineeId and trainerId excluded from public share-card response
business_rules_verified.summary_persistence: Stored in session_summaries collection keyed by sessionId
business_rules_verified.auto_generation: Summary auto-generated when trainer ends session via POST /api/sessions/{id}/end
